verdict.rationale: While Inngest exposes a REST API (inngest-docs-7) and SDK version paths (e.g. /v4/ in inngest-docs-14), the evidence pack contains no documented API versioning scheme or deprecation policy; the closest doc (inngest-docs-19) actually describes avoiding explicit version markers for function changes, not an API deprecation policy. No changelog, migration guide, or deprecation timeline is evidenced.
